description_en: Deletes a scaling plan from an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb delete-elastic-plan --elastic-plan-name test --db-cluster-id amv-wz9509beptiz0000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteElasticPlan

parameters.help_en:
